title: urostachys pithyoides

It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include being used to treat gastrointestinal issues, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Urostachys pithyoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
